## Original source and creator

Link the original public post and creator profile.

## Visible demonstration

Link the playable video or image, publication date and the task shown. Preserve the publisher's model label and any comparison conditions.

## Why it belongs

Describe the visible output and a useful takeaway. A complete prompt is optional. Mention an existing case if this is another view of the same work.

## Attribution and rights

Confirm attribution and identify any reuse restrictions. Do not include credentials or private material.
